visual_elements.description: ROC curve plot. Y-axis labeled TPR (red, vertical). X-axis labeled FPR (red, horizontal). Origin at bottom-left. Multiple curves originate at (0,0) and end near top-right (1,1). Top curve is magenta/purple with white circular markers, bowing toward top-left corner; yellow shaded area beneath it. Middle curve is green with markers. Lower curve is blue with markers. Several thin straight green lines radiate from origin toward top-right. A dark blue line goes from origin to top-right corner. Grid lines visible in light gray. Annotation 'Best Model Largest Area Under the Curve' in magenta text with two magenta arrows pointing to the top purple curve. Annotation 'Worst Model Smallest Area Under the Curve' in dark blue text on the right with two dark blue arrows pointing to lower curves/lines.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold, larger, red, sentence case. Subtitle line inside box is bold blue. Body lines are regular black. Axis labels are red. Annotation texts are colored to match associated curves (magenta for best, dark blue for worst). No italics visible. Numbered bullets not used.
animation_state: Static; all elements appear fully revealed.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray (#f0f0f0) background. 2. Add a thin maroon rectangular border around the slide content area. 3. Add a black horizontal strip across the very bottom edge. 4. Add title text 'Area Under the Curve (AUC)' centered at top, bold red sans-serif, approx 28-32pt. 5. Add a yellow circle with '37' in black at top-right corner. 6. Insert a white rectangle text box below the title spanning most of the slide width, with a thin red border. Inside it, add three lines: first line blue bold 'Compare between different models (at different thresholds for each model)'; second line black 'Best Model is the model trying to reach the point at [FBR=0, TPR=1]'; third line black 'In other words, Best model is the model that has the largest area under the curve'. 7. Below the text box, insert or draw an ROC chart: X-axis 'FPR' in red at bottom with arrowhead, Y-axis 'TPR' in red on left with arrowhead, light gray grid. Plot a magenta curve from (0,0) bowing to top-left then to (1,1) with white circular markers; fill yellow area under it. Plot a green curve with markers below it. Plot a blue curve with markers below that. Draw several thin green straight lines from origin to top-right. Draw a dark blue diagonal line from origin to top-right. 8. Add magenta text annotation 'Best Model Largest Area Under the Curve' above the magenta curve with two magenta arrows pointing down to it. 9. Add dark blue text annotation 'Worst Model Smallest Area Under the Curve' on the right side with two dark blue arrows pointing to the lower curves.
